scope: filesystem and named-root metadata diagnosis; not an owner admission/release decision
diagnosis: The cooperative 145 GB logical cap is the obstacle; physical filesystem free space and inode counts are ample.

The owner charges named-root apparent bytes for every regular pathname, including every hardlink alias, plus the FULL amount of every nonreleased reservation. This is an intentional contract, not numerical evidence of the same bytes being mistakenly counted twice.

Ordinary du suppresses duplicate hardlinked inodes. Its much lower total is unsuitable for admission. --count-links approximates owner size accounting but the pure metadata census precisely excludes directory sizes.

31.55 GB of the observed pathname total comes from repeated hardlink aliases. Several large source/validation snapshots embed archive weights, proof keys and archived evidence; hardlinking these captures reduced physical cost but did not reduce the agreed logical charge.
Temporary pytest roots are active and growing. pytest-157 has a present process lock; lack of a lock for other directories does not establish deletion authority.
Named root inode/dev identities match the ledger, including tmp inode 524352. No new migration appears needed from this bounded observation.
